summary: The `contains_text()` method has been correctly implemented in `tinydb/queries.py`. It performs a case-sensitive substring check on string values only, returning False for non-strings (missing fields, None, numbers, etc.) without errors. The method is composable with other queries and properly integrates with the query caching mechanism. All 233 tests pass, including the 5 new acceptance criteria tests.

checks.claim: contains_text() matches substring in string fields case-sensitively
Non-string values (None, numbers, missing fields) return False without error
checks.evidence: test_ac3_contains_text_non_string passes; manual test confirms empty result for age:30, name:None, {}
test_ac5_contains_text_composable passes; manual test confirms (q.name.contains_text('son')) & (q.active == True) works

checks.claim: Query caching works correctly for same/different substrings
checks.evidence: Manual test shows same substring produces equal queries with same hash; different substrings produce different queries
